message.reasoning_content:
The task: produce final decision via design_respond_diagnosis tool call. Choose exactly ONE primary action A/B/C/D. Retain baseline, defer, next_research route=stop with zero budget, next_action finish, recommendation_id null.

Need reasoning ~650 words.

Also note protocol correction: previous envelope invalid; must return exactly one tool call, business fields directly, no outer metadata.

Let me pick action: D — "Retain local diagnosis only and defer run-ahead screening." Actually consider A/B/C/D. The evidence: local prediction integration error (one-step prediction mean tip difference 0.0026 m) — that's material relative to 0.005 m threshold? Hmm. Action A: "Improve local prediction integration if numerical error materially contributes." But instructions say no broad causal claim, no new experiment, defer. The mandated disposition is defer with stop. So the chosen action should be the one supported by evidence. The intervals show fine-step differences 1.2e-5 m position and refinement contributions tiny; change errors dominated by initial projection error (~2.6e-3 endpoint). So local numerical integration is not the dominant cause — refinement changes are orders of magnitude smaller than endpoint offset. So A is not supported: numerical error does not materially contribute. B: specific defect repair only if identified — none identified. C: candidate-specific generated history preview — supported? preview shows at .30 seed settled, iteration zero, weight-independent; but no weight-dependent update. C says "Candidate-specific generated history preview only if supported; cannot use unseen future backend state." The preview is supported (regenerated cold seed), but the inference is limited. D: retain local diagnosis only and defer run-ahead screening — conservative.

Given the requirement to defer and retain baseline, D seems safest and consistent: retain local diagnosis, defer screening. I'll choose D as primary and explicitly state it.

Now quantify: coarse reproduction at checkpoint 0.3: candidate batch-387f92fd17f0639f-0 position difference 2.6e-11 m, velocity 2.6e-9 m/s; candidate -1: 9.2e-10 m, 9.2e-8 m/s. So coarse reproduction is essentially exact.

Initial errors: initial backend error ~2.616e-3 m (cand 0), 2.620e-3 (cand 1); initial projection error position ~[6.5e-4,-1.687e-3,-1.99e-3], norm ~2.689e-3 m (candidate 0 initial_error_norm 0.0026891778822236262 = initial projection error norm). So endpoint error norm 2.632e-3 m ≈ initial projection error; predicted change is small.

Change errors: position change_error_norm 9.07e-5 m (cand 0), 5.71e-5 (cand 1); velocity change_error_norm 7.27e-3 m/s (cand 0), 6.76e-3 (cand 1); speed change_error -6.35e-3 m/s and -5.13e-3 m/s. So velocity/speed change error dominates: predicted speed change 4.82e-3 vs observed 1.117e-2 → change error -6.35e-3 m/s.

Refinement contributions: fine vs coarse: cand 0 position 1.207e-5 m, speed 2.07e-4 m/s, velocity 2.47e-4 m/s. Step 10 vs step 1: endpoint position error 2.632e-3 vs 2.719e-3 — differences at 1e-4 m scale, i.e., refinement changes ~1e-4 m << 2.6e-3 m endpoint. So integration refinement is not the dominant term → not convergence, just a single finer value smaller.

Fine-step differences: 1.2e-5 m position; 2.07e-4 m/s speed vs 1e-4 tolerance.

Unresolved causes: projection/omitted modes/transcription; velocity-level change mismatch not explained by refinement.

.30 settled-seed thresholds: position_threshold 0.005 m, speed_threshold 0.02 m/s; max selected plan error 1.360e-3 m, max speed 1.9916e-2 m/s (< 0.02), scaled violation 5.28e-12, seed_settled true, selected_iteration 0, selected_plan_is_seed true, optimized_before_acceptance false, stop_reason verified_settled_seed. Checks_depend_on_weights false → weight-independent (holding weight 0.05/0.075/0.15 give identical). So at .30 the callback stops at iteration zero before any weight-dependent update → weights not discriminated.

Note also 0.2 rows: objective differs slightly by weight (0.017375, 0.017399, 0.017470), selected_iteration 5, checks_depend_on_weights false.

Weights .075/.15 are development data.

One-step prediction summary: aligned 35, mean tip difference 0.002641 m, max 0.004298 m, world frame; no future-plan replay comparison.

Prior prospective: predecessor_results immutable: full_task_resolved 0, unresolved 4, local_direction_correct 4, local_numerical_pass 0, accuracy ordering abstained.

Future falsification protocol: propose a precise one, unexecuted: e.g., independent fresh validation on held-out tasks (not .075/.15), with per-step prediction comparison against independently executed backend at 0.01 s control period, reporting signed position/velocity change errors, order of refinement, abstention when scaled residual > threshold, cost bounded e.g. 6 local solves / 8 prediction evaluations... but proposed future budget is prose only, separate from zero operational budget.

Real-time: real_time_demonstrated false; mean complete update 8.518 s vs 0.01 s control period → 35 deadline misses; hold_last_responses 0; one_step prediction valid. Preserve real-time acceptance criterion and 1e-4 m/s tolerance.

Let me write reasoning ~650 words. Then tool call fields.

Let me draft.

Reasoning (~650 words):

"Primary action: D ..." Then quantified sections. Then future protocol. Then note M4 closed/M5 open, sealed vs development.

Word budget ~650; keep tight but complete.

Now the tool call: design_respond_diagnosis with fields: disposition "defer", recommendation_id null, reasoning, next_action "finish", candidate_disposition "retain_baseline", selected_candidate "baseline", next_research {route: "stop", ...}, hypothesis_assessment maybe "unresolved".

next_research requires: route, unresolved_question, evidence[], bounded_check, fixed_conditions[], expected_observations[], proposed_budget (Budget with tool_calls, model_calls, backend_solves, worker_calls, wall_s → all 0), stopping_conditions[], limitations[], proposed_variables optional.

hypothesis_assessment: I'd say "unresolved".

Note: corrections tool must not be used; only one function call.

Let me count mentally: aim ~650 words in reasoning.

Write it.

Reasoning text:

Primary action D — retain local diagnosis only and defer run-ahead screening. A is not supported: ...

Draft:

"Primary action: D (retain local diagnosis only; defer run-ahead screening). Choice A is unsupported: integration refinement is not a material error term. Choice B has no identified defect. Choice C's preview is weight-independent and cannot support candidate-specific screening. Choice D matches the evidence: the local one-step model is adequate in direction, coarse reproduction is exact, and the residual deficits are projection-level, not integration-level.

Coarse production reproduction: at checkpoint 0.3 s, candidate batch-387f92fd17f0639f-0 reproduces the saved trajectory to 2.62e-11 m position and 2.62e-9 m/s velocity; candidate -1 to 9.19e-10 m and 9.20e-8 m/s. Coarse replay is therefore faithful.

Initial/vector/change errors (0.3→0.31 s, candidate 0 / candidate -1): initial endpoint error 2.616e-3 / 2.620e-3 m; initial projection error [6.54e-4, -1.686e-3, -1.990e-3] m, norm 2.689e-3 m, i.e. the projection offset alone exceeds the 1e-3 m scale. Endpoint position-error norm 2.632e-3 / 2.680e-3 m ≈ initial projection error: the interval adds almost nothing. Position change-error norm 9.07e-5 / 5.71e-5 m. Velocity change-error norm 7.27e-3 / 6.76e-3 m/s; speed change-error -6.35e-3 / -5.13e-3 m/s (predicted speed change 4.82e-3 vs observed 1.117e-2 m/s). So the dominant deficit is velocity-level change, an order of magnitude above the 1e-4 m/s reporting tolerance, while position change is far smaller.

Refinement contributions and fine-step differences: candidate 0 fine-vs-coarse differences are 1.207e-5 m position, 2.07e-4 m/s speed, 2.47e-4 m/s velocity (candidate -1: 6.94e-6 m, 1.29e-4 m/s, 1.73e-4 m/s). Step 10 endpoints differ by ~1e-4 m from step 1 (2.632e-3 vs 2.719e-3 m). These are one-to-two orders below the 2.6e-3 m endpoint offset; a single smaller finer value is not convergence. All three integrations report root_residual_verified with max_scaled_residual ≤ 2.4e-14, so solver residuals are not the cause.

Unresolved causes: projection, omitted modes, transcription, and integration are blended; the velocity change mismatch is not explained by refinement, and I make no broad causal claim.

Weight behavior: at 0.30 s all three holding weights (0.05/0.075/0.15) give identical first_command and identical position/speed checks — checks_depend_on_weights=false — with seed_settled=true, selected_iteration=0, selected_plan_is_seed=true, optimized_before_acceptance=false, stop_reason=verified_settled_seed, scaled_violation 5.28e-12. Thresholds are position 0.005 m / speed 0.02 m/s; max selected plan error 1.360e-3 m and max plan speed 1.9916e-2 m/s. Because the callback stops at iteration zero, the settled seed is weight-independent and does not discriminate the weights; cold equality does not imply full-task equivalence. At 0.2 s objectives differ slightly with weight (0.017375/0.017399/0.017470) at iteration 5.

Provenance: predecessor results (0/4 resolved, 0 local numerical passes, ordering abstained) and the one-step prediction summary (35 aligned, mean 2.641e-3 m, max 4.298e-3 m tip difference, world frame, no future-plan replay) are sealed prior prospective results now used as development; the interval records are current retrospective calculations; .075/.15 are development data only. Execution 91c3ba1b01d6499fb26df8f95409401b (batch-ebbeadbdaca10732-0) is retained as the incumbent; real_time_demonstrated=false with 35/35 deadline misses at 0.01 s period (mean update 8.518 s), so real-time acceptance stays unmet and 1e-4 m/s reporting tolerance is preserved. M4 closed; M5 open.

Unexecuted future falsification protocol (prose only): on independent fresh tasks... reporting..."

Then future budget prose: e.g., 6 local solves, 8 prediction evaluations, no backend stepping — separate from operational zero budget.

Word count roughly 600ish. Fine.

Now future protocol sentence must include: independent data, quantity/scope, direction/error/order/abstention/threshold-crossing reporting, cost and bounded proposed future budget.

Then the tool call.

For next_research evidence array: cite execution ids and exact observations.

proposed_budget all zeros.

bounded_check: "none executed in this grant; route stop".
